source: Original (2026-11-18, calculator, radians). Ferris wheel diameter 40 m, centre 25 m, period 12 min, h(t) = d - a cos(bt). Easier than 3-6Q (a) P4: no phase shift.

parts.label: a
parts.description: Find a and d for h(t) = d - a cos(bt).
parts.notes: A1 for a = 20. A1 for d = 25. a = 40 (diameter): A0.

parts.label: b
parts.notes: M1 for 2pi/b = 12. A1 for pi/6. b = 12 or 12/(2pi): M0A0.

parts.label: c
parts.notes: M1 for substituting t = 2. A1 for 15. Degree mode gives 5.00: M1A0.

parts.label: d
parts.description: Find the first time the seat is 40 m above the ground.
parts.notes: M1 for h(t) = 40 or a graph with y = 40. A1 for 4.62. Degree mode gives 265: M1A0.

parts.label: e
parts.description: Find the time per turn for which the seat is more than 40 m high.
parts.notes: M1 for the second time 7.38 (symmetry about t = 6 or GDC). A1 for 2.76. Giving 7.38 as the answer: M1A0.

source: Original (2026-11-18, calculator, radians). Tide D(t) = a sin(b(t - c)) + d, 0 < c < 4; high 8.4 m at 04:00, low 1.6 m at 10:15. Difficulty of 3-6Q (a) P4.

parts.label: a
parts.notes: A1 for a = 3.4. A1 for d = 5. a = 6.8 or a and d swapped: A0 for that value.

parts.label: b
parts.description: Find the period in hours, and hence b.
parts.notes: A1 for period 12.5. A1 for b = 2pi/12.5. Period 6.25 (b = 1.01): A0A0 but FT later.

parts.label: c
parts.notes: M1 for b(4 - c) = pi/2 (maximum condition) or quarter period before high tide; minimum condition b(10.25 - c) = 3pi/2 also accepted. A1 for 0.875. c = 4 (cosine shift): M0A0.

parts.label: d
parts.tolerance: Accept 4.36 or 4.37 from a rounded b.
parts.notes: M1 for D(13). A1 for 4.36. Degree mode 5.36: M1A0. c = 4 gives 1.66: FT only.

parts.label: e
parts.description: Boat needs depth at least 3.5 m: find the time between the 04:00 and 16:30 high tides when it cannot enter.
parts.tolerance: Accept 4.43 h or about 4 h 26 min.
parts.notes: M1 for D(t) = 3.5 or a graph with y = 3.5. A1 for both times 8.03 and 12.5 (12.466). A1 for 4.43. 8.07 (time it can enter): M1A1A0.
